title: Pure Gate Guardian
summary: The Gate Guardian family only: Sanga of the Thunder, Kazejin and Suijin, the Gate Guardians, and the 2023-2024 Labyrinth support that names them, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Labyrinth Heavy Tank Normal Summons without tributing and places one of the three brothers face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. With a Labyrinth Wall card out, it also destroys a monster. Labyrinth Wall Shadow, the Field Spell, places one each turn too, and Shadow Ghoul of the Labyrinth searches it. Brothers placed that way count as cards you control, so they can be banished for the Gate Guardian Fusions. Gate Guardians Combined negates targeting effects three times a turn, and Gate Guardian of Wind and Water negates Spells and Traps. Dark Element, the newest card (2024), pays half your LP to summon Gate Guardian or Dark Guardian from anywhere. Double Attack! Wind and Thunder!!, Riryoku Guardian and Prey of the Jirai Gumo each banish themselves to fetch a brother back.
